Subject: Request: onboarding without PO for pilot (ZeldaAI)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — excited by what Redwood Inference can do for our summarization pipeline. We're a small startup (seed-stage, ~12 people) and we don't issue purchase orders as part of our internal ops. For the pilot we'd like to move quickly: can Redwood onboard us without a PO and accept invoice-only billing for the initial 60-day pilot?

What we can provide immediately: signed SOW-style pilot confirmation, W-9, and a copy of our bank remittance info if needed. If you require a payment card on file we can discuss, but our preferred path is invoice net30.

I've attached the completed onboarding form for your intake team. If there's any standard pilot annex or short contract we need to sign, please send it over and we'll get legal to review.

Attachments: [ZeldaAI_Onboarding_Form.pdf]

Best,
Alex Park

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: onboarding without PO for pilot (ZeldaAI)

Marissa / Kim — forwarding a request from ZeldaAI. They're asking for a no-PO onboarding path for a 60-day pilot (small vendor, ~12 people). Attached onboarding form from Alex.

Key points / questions:
- They prefer invoice net30; no PO issued on their side.
- We need to decide if we approve an "invoice-only pilot" (conditional approval) or require a purchase order.
- If we approve, what conditions do we place on spend cap, payment method (ACH/card), and required artifacts (W-9, insurance, SOC2 attestation)?

My recommendation: approve a conditional pilot (60 days) under a temporary vendor code, cap initial spend at $10k, require W-9 + signed pilot annex that limits liability and specifies termination on non-payment. If finance/legal are comfortable, we can proceed.

Please advise and loop in Laura from Finance for the vendor setup and invoicing path.

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: [ZeldaAI_Onboarding_Form.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Park <alex@zeldaai.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding without PO for pilot (ZeldaAI)

Marcus — thanks for the context and for attaching their form. I support a conditional exception for early-stage pilots, provided we add the following guardrails:

- Pilot term: 60 days, with automatic suspension after 60 days unless a standard contract or PO is in place.
- Spend cap: $10,000 total for the pilot. Any exceed must be pre-approved by Procurement.
- Payment terms: invoice net30 OR card-on-file/ACH; if invoice net30 chosen, require a first invoice within 14 days of start.
- Required docs: completed W-9, evidence of entity registration, billing contact + remittance details.
- Legal: sign a short "pilot annex" that includes payment fallback, data handling basics, and termination clause for non-payment.

I can approve this under the "small vendor invoice-only pilot" workflow. Kim, can you confirm Finance will issue a temporary vendor code and the appropriate GL mapping?

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Related: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/1892

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding without PO for pilot (ZeldaAI)

Thanks — looping in Finance (Laura). Finance is generally comfortable with a temporary vendor setup for pilots, provided we collect the following before any invoice is paid or processed:

- W-9 (verified)
- Bank remit instructions for ACH or a valid billing email for invoicing
- Invoice header that includes our assigned temporary vendor code and the deal reference (ZELDA-DEAL-1892)

Operational note: we will create a temporary vendor record with limited payment channels and a manual review for any single invoice > $2,500. Please confirm whether ZeldaAI will accept ACH or need net30 invoice by email. If they insist on no PO and no ACH, we'll ask Legal for additional payment protections.

Laura — can you stand up the temporary vendor code and confirm GL mapping for trials? I'll attach the pilot annex template for Legal review.

Kimberly Park
FinOps Partner | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Alex — good news, Procurement and Finance can onboard ZeldaAI for a 60-day pilot under a conditional invoice-only path. Summary of what we need from you to proceed:

1) Signed pilot annex (we've attached a template internally; we'll send the DocuSign link once Legal confirms language).
2) Completed W-9 (PDF) and entity verification.
3) Remittance instructions (ACH preferred) or billing email for invoices.

Terms we've agreed: 60-day pilot, spend cap $10,000 total, invoice net30 (or ACH), temporary vendor code, manual review for any invoice > $2,500. If payment is late we reserve the right to suspend access.

Next steps:
- Alex: please confirm which payment method you prefer and return W-9.
- Marissa/Legal: please prepare the pilot annex for signature and confirm DocuSign link.
- Kim/Finance: please create the temporary vendor code and share vendor setup checklist with Alex.
